items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: Ross and I stayed there a couple of days. Then Bennie heard about us being over there, and he sent three cars over there and picked us up.

ctx.x: Yeah, they caught us. But they didn't bother us, as long as we didn't go in none of them cars that had merchandise in them. Because Ross got to running down through there, and then they told us..> Two of them detectives were (?). They said, "Man, don't run. They'll shoot you." And he run, and he come on up there and he told us what had happened, and they said, "Well, don't be hanging around them cars with that food and stuff in there." We said, "We just tryin' to get home, tryin' to get home..." And they left us…
Why did the Blue Devils want to hire Lester Young, when he was almost the only saxophone player in the world who didn't sound like Coleman Hawkins?
